notes:
- Mid-market B2B SaaS: embedded workflow automation for ops teams.
- Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first (fast path) with clear intent to move to Dedicated if latency/cost metrics align.
- Primary workload: multi-step agentic chat that does: user query -> vector search -> tool call (ticket creation / CRM action) -> follow-up clarification.
- Latency SLO: streaming first token < 200ms (target), end-to-end action completion ideally < 1s for local ops tasks, acceptable up to 2s for multi-tool chains.
- Concern from engineering: tool-call timeouts cascade and cause whole agent session failure. "If search times out, agent gives user a hard error" — quote from CTO Lina Park.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market, want predictable unit economics; experiment with hosted during demo, then price/commit conversation for Dedicated (monthly commit + burst).
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, audit logs, retention controls; prefer KMS integration and US data residency.
- POC asks: simulated 1k DAU traffic profile for 2 week window; canonical prompt set + failure injection for tool latencies; need baseline perf numbers (p50/p95/p99).
- Notes from 2026-03-02 demo: streaming looked clean, but observed one tool-call retry path that added 800ms; SE suggested circuit-breaker + fallback to cached result.
- Quote from product lead: "We need graceful degradation — don't surface raw tool errors to users."
- Internal champions: Lina Park (CTO), Marco Ruiz (Product Lead). AE engaged: Ethan Rivera. SE: Priya Nair. CSM tentatively Luis Ortega if move to Dedicated.

poc_summary: Running 2-week Hosted API POC: target traffic profile ~1k daily active agents with mixed short (single-turn) and long (multi-tool) flows. Evaluate: latency (streaming first byte, p50/p95/p99), tool-call success rate under induced 200-700ms third-party search latencies, and cost per completed agent session. Success criteria: p95 streaming first token < 350ms, tool-call retry rate < 3%, graceful fallback implemented for failed calls, and cost estimate within forecasted ARR band.
use_case_summary: Agentic internal ops assistant: conversational UI for troubleshooting + automations. Typical flow: user asks a question -> system performs vector search (internal docs) -> agent decides to call one or more tools (ticket create, run a query, write-back to CRM) -> returns structured summary + next actions. Requires streaming responses, function/tool calling, and predictable tail latency for tool interactions.
notes_short: Evaluating Hosted -> Dedicated. Focus: low-latency streaming, reliable tool-calls, fallback strategies. Next: finalize POC metrics & pricing.
